name: truthpitch-merch
description: Minimal merch store for TruthPitch.com — Next.js storefront on Shopify + Printful, with a small admin panel.
//scripts: Tools are called via `node node_modules/...` instead of their bin shims so scripts also work in folders whose path contains & or ( ) on Windows. Production builds use --webpack because Turbopack needs Next's native compiler, which can't load on Hostinger's older Linux build servers.

scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-db.mjs && node node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate && node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build --webpack

//overrides: deepmerge-ts is forced to 8.x to fix CVE-2026-40345 (pulled in by prisma > @prisma/config, which pins 7.1.5).
